Technical

Stats

Surgeon_Nurse
Sister Clara is an Undead Nurse in Reithwin during Act Two.

Involvement

Act Two

Clara's corpse is on the upper level of the operating theatre in the House of Healing, where  Malus Thorm performs a live surgery on a struggling  Distressed Patient. Thorm may revive Clara to fight as his ally through  Lovely Assistant.
